# nocthost_providers (Data Source)

Cloud backends that take deploys right now, and regions that are temporarily paused on a backend (`GET /servers/providers`). Check it before picking `provider_id` and `region_id`. Requires an API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nocthost_providers" "current" {}

output "available_providers" {
  value = [for p in data.nocthost_providers.current.providers : p.id if p.available]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `outages` (Attributes List) Regions temporarily paused on a backend. A deploy there returns an error until it reopens. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--outages))
- `providers` (Attributes List) Cloud backends. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))

<a id="nestedatt--outages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `outages`

Read-Only:

- `provider_id` (String) Cloud backend ID.
- `reason` (String) Human-readable reason.
- `region_id` (String) Region code.


<a id="nestedatt--providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the backend takes new deploys now.
- `id` (String) ID to use as `provider_id` on `nocthost_server`.
- `label` (String) Display name.
